own_solution.law: Tsiolkovsky: v = u ln((md + mf)/md) = 3 ln 4 km/s
assumptions: constant exhaust speed relative to rocket

notes: Agrees with pass 1 (pass 1 used m/s; 4158.88 m/s = 4.15888 km/s, 3692.64 m/s = 3.69264 km/s). Checked R answers: 3 ln(3250/850) = 3 * 1.34117 = 4.02352; 3 ln(3390/990) = 3.69264; 3 ln(3510/1110) = 3 * 1.15126 = 3.45377 km/s. The burn-rate cancellation is correct (final speed independent of rate in field-free space). Minimal pairs T2E45-T5A37 and T3A6F-T5460 share 190 kg and differ only in attachment/occasion; T23F7 and T357D are declared numeral-free twins. The base text explicitly excludes payload from the empty mass, so the R wiring md + q is justified.
